reason: The only available combination follows the distant ice and addresses the remaining goal.

reaction: The contrast between the captured ice and the freed rubble world made the encounter more interesting.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the rubble world through both encounters was most worthwhile: it survived intact but lost its sun.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final ice combination was the only available action, so it felt less like a decision, even though its outcome was informative.

surprise.text: The passing star freed the rubble world without capturing it, yet captured some distant ice through the same encounter.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the offered encounters had clear purposes, though the menu supplied the compatible choices.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to follow the sunless world and see how its story develops.
